items.difficulty_reason: The proof takes the scheme-side fpqc sheaf proposition as the key fact, then runs an explicit \'etale-chart reduction: lift a compatible family $b_i : T_i \to B$ through charts $U_i \to T_i \times_T U$, obtain $a : U \to B$ from the scheme case, use uniqueness to get $a \circ \mathrm{pr}_0 = a \circ \mathrm{pr}_1$ on $U \times_T U$, and conclude with the sheaf-quotient presentation $T = U/(U \times_T U)$ plus the final diagram bookkeeping.
